description: This file defines sampler classes for Apache Spark's RDDs, including base and specialized samplers such as range and stratified samplers, used for sampling data in distributed processing.

classes.name: RDDSamplerBase
classes.description: Base class providing common sampling functionalities such as uniform and Poisson sampling.

classes.name: RDDSampler
classes.description: Sampler class for sampling with or without replacement based on a fraction.

classes.name: RDDRangeSampler
classes.description: Sampler class for range-based sampling within specified bounds.

classes.name: RDDStratifiedSampler
classes.description: Sampler class for stratified sampling based on provided fractions per key.

methods.name: initRandomGenerator
methods.description: Initializes the random generator with a seed based on the split.

methods.name: getUniformSample
methods.description: Returns a uniform random sample between 0 and 1.

methods.name: getPoissonSample
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed sample count based on the mean.

methods.name: func
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for sampling logic.
